pages.title: Finding Vyroxeres
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 0 to 120. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 5.

pages.title: Working Vyroxeres
pages.text: Smelt Vyroxeres Ore or Vyroxeres Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 487 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 5.$(br)Mining efficiency: 11.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 6.2.$(br)Enchantability: 16.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 3.0.$(br)Enchantability: 16.

pages.title: Weapon: Toxin
pages.text: Poisons the target on every hit, if the target is already poisoned, the level of poison debuff increases.

pages.title: Armor: Dissolve
pages.text: Additional Damage Reduction for every active potion effect on the user.
